WATERS takeshiba

3D scan of a waterfront complex in Takeshiba, Tokyo

We 3D-scanned this waterfront complex in Takeshiba, facing Hama-rikyu Gardens and Tokyo Bay. The waterside plaza, the deck and the 2F terrace are now a 3DGS you can walk through in the browser. The on-site work took about one hour, with the cooperation of the facility.

Location
WATERS takeshiba (1-10-30 Kaigan, Minato-ku, Tokyo)
Scan
2026.10.21 ／ about 1 hour on site
Scenes
1F waterside plaza & deck ／ 2F terrace
Use
Walkthrough published on the location page, for scouting and planning angles
